# 3 bed house for sale

> 13 Mount Prospect Park is a three-bedroom end-of-terrace family home ideally situated in this mature and highly convenient Clontarf location. Extended to the rear, the property offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation, complemented by a sunny rear garden and off-street parking to the front.
